chunks: And from his speech (peace be upon him), referring to one of his companions,
those who died before the occurrence of the tribulations (fitan).

key_terms.أَصْحَابِهِ: His companions (referring to the companions of the Imam)
key_terms.الْفِتَنِ: Tribulations, civil strife, or trials (specifically referring to the early Islamic conflicts like Jamal and Siffin)

ai.seo_question: Who among the companions died before the fitan according to Nahj al-Balagha?
ai.summary: Imam Ali (peace be upon him) highlights the specific companion's fortune in passing away before the outbreak of the First Fitna, a pivotal era of civil strife that tested the loyalty and faith of the early Muslim community. This observation underscores the Shia scholarly emphasis on divine protection for the righteous who are spared the moral complexities and political turmoil of subsequent generations, reflecting the concept of 'salamah' (safety) from tribulation.

en.sayed-ali-raza: who passed away from this world before the occurrence of troubles.
